description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Curfew Order under Section 16, Curfew from 18.00 hour of 14.05.2022 until 5.00 hour of 15.05.2022
reasoning: This gazette content is a Curfew Order issued under Section 16 of the Public Security Ordinance. It establishes a legal regulation restricting public movement in specified areas during designated hours. This falls under "Legal notices and statutory declarations" and "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" within the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5), as it creates a legally binding public order requirement rather than dealing with government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
